_doc: THESE FOUR CARRY A NAME AND NO FILL. The sheet letters them straight onto the unclaimed relief, so there is no boundary to extract and inventing one would be drawing a claim the author declined to draw. They are emitted as POINTS in the `areas` channel, whose published note already says exactly this: where a NAME sits, never where the thing is. The Enclave is the sharpest case - the sheet's own legend-less convention gives it capitals the size of CAESAR'S LEGION while drawing it no ground at all.
